linux.observation: Actual seeded5223 arena: visible rails bridge dry lowered pits, matching solid rock props and door portals. Hornfel and thrown payload are visible; the far-side cart approaches HUD overlap.
Cart, wheels and rider are distinct from a generic monster model. Body follows rail direction; shared rails cast shadows.
The rider is on foot after cart loss. Phase2 health and escape instruction are visible. No cart body remains attached.

wasm.observation: Actual seeded boss and dry pit footprint match native Original presentation. A thrown bomb, its danger ring, explosion and red radial aftermath are visible; small shots overlap rails and blast particles.

Escape removes boss and health bar, closes rail doors and satisfies the guardian objective. Probe verifies zero kill events and no additional dynamite; isolated debug scene intentionally does not certify ordinary room-clear flow.

limitations: Only listed captures were individually inspected. Other case captures are preserved as probe evidence, not all-camera visual review.
Cart can leave the camera view or overlap HUD at far arena edges; small ordnance and rail clutter require readability acceptance.
Source charge/recovery, decoys, other passengers and fireplace props are not rendered because their controllers remain unfinished.
Dry pit edges interpolate on the existing low-poly height-field lattice; rail bridges currently use rails and ties without extra architectural supports.
No controlled rendered performance acceptance; frame counters during concurrent regression are not a benchmark.
